description: DATASUS column metadata - shared between climasus4r and climasus4py. schema_version 2 (2026-09-21) splits what used to be a single all_numeric_columns list of 23 entries into three, because those 23 were three different kinds of column and coercing all of them with to_numeric corrupted the identifiers: measured on SIM-DO SP 2023, 13294 of 262909 rows with CODESTAB (5.1%) lost leading zeros, e.g. 10049 for CNES 0010049. all_numeric_columns now lists ONLY genuine quantities, so a consumer that keeps coercing it is doing the right thing. all_identifier_columns maps each fixed-width code to its width (null where the width is not known; none are null today) and must be kept as text, padded and never used in arithmetic. all_categorical_columns must be kept as text so the values match the label books in dictionaries/*/categories.json. GRAESSION was dropped: it matches no column in any available DATASUS file, no field in the climasus4r dictionaries and no entry in any columns.json. CODOCUPMAE is 6 because the CBO-2002 occupation code is six digits -- it appears in no SIM-DO file available here, so the width comes from the code system and not from measurement, as the M5 stopgap already declared. See M64 and M5.
